goal_or_hypothesis: Host cardplay requests must not expose hidden skat, unqualified private cards, or point totals inconsistent with lawful public play.
nearest_gate: Deployment host observation legality and leakage safety
smallest_intervention: At host ingress reject unsupported known_private_cards; require skat_cards only for pickup declarer and disjoint from hand/history; verify optional point totals against replayed public tricks and owned discarded skat.
invariants_to_preserve: No Java host adoption or model strength claim
resource_bound: Source and focused synthetic tests only
success_criteria: Valid visible state accepted; hidden skat, unsupported private cards, and fabricated points rejected before policy invocation.
failure_or_stop_criteria: Product/bridge regression or visibility ambiguity; keep release gate closed until resolved.
